quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a small fruit with skin so thin you can see its inner veins.
quests.hint: It's usually too tart to enjoy raw, so it's cooked into pies instead.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Gooseberry is a small fruit with skin so thin you can see its inner veins.
quests.funFact: Some varieties of gooseberries actually have tiny, fuzzy hairs on them.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a small fruit whose name means hair, thanks to its spiky covering?
quests.hint: It looks a lot like a spikier cousin of another small red fruit.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Rambutan is a small fruit whose name means hair, thanks to its spiky covering.
quests.funFact: Inside the wild-looking shell is a sweet, juicy fruit with a pit.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a huge fruit whose stringy yellow flesh can taste a little like pulled meat?
quests.hint: Its stringy flesh is sometimes used in cooking as a meat substitute.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Jackfruit is a huge fruit whose stringy yellow flesh can taste a little like pulled meat.
quests.funFact: Did you know? jackfruit is the largest tree-borne fruit in the entire world.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a small round fruit that grows in clusters on a tall tree.
quests.hint: Its outer skin is red and slightly rough to the touch.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lychee is a small round fruit that grows in clusters on a tall tree.
quests.funFact: You must easily peel away the red shell to eat the fruit inside.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a ridged tropical fruit with five pointed edges running down its sides.
quests.hint: It has five ridges running down its sides.
quests.explanation: That's right! Star Fruit is a ridged tropical fruit with five pointed edges running down its sides.
quests.funFact: Its scientific name is carambola.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a fragrant fruit that turns a deep rosy pink once it's cooked.
quests.hint: Cooking turns its pale flesh into a surprising rosy pink.
quests.explanation: Great job! Quince is a fragrant fruit that turns a deep rosy pink once it's cooked.
quests.funFact: When you cook a quince for a long time, it miraculously turns bright pink.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a small dark purple fruit that grows in clusters on a leafy tree?
quests.hint: Its shape looks a bit like a stretched-out version of another dark berry.
quests.explanation: You got it! Mulberry is a small dark purple fruit that grows in clusters on a leafy tree.
quests.funFact: Silkworms rely entirely on mulberry leaves as their only source of food.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a crunchy, juicy fruit you can eat whole, skin and all?
quests.hint: You can eat its skin along with the rest of the fruit.
quests.explanation: Well done! Star Fruit is a crunchy, juicy fruit you can eat whole, skin and all.
quests.funFact: Did you know? when you slice a star fruit horizontally, every piece looks like a perfect five-pointed star.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a lumpy yellow fruit that's too hard and tart to eat raw.
quests.hint: It's too hard and sour to eat raw, so it's almost always cooked first.
quests.explanation: Correct! Quince is a lumpy yellow fruit that's too hard and tart to eat raw.
quests.funFact: They are packed with pectin and make excellent jams and jellies.

quests.instruction: Which one is a berry whose skin shows faint stripes running from top to bottom?
quests.hint: It's small, round, and quite tart on its own.
quests.explanation: Super! Gooseberry is a berry whose skin shows faint stripes running from top to bottom.
quests.funFact: They are famous for being baked into incredibly tart, sweet pies.

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a tropical fruit packed with more vitamin C than an orange?
quests.hint: It actually beats an orange in one important vitamin.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Guava is a tropical fruit packed with more vitamin C than an orange.
quests.funFact: They have four times more Vitamin C than a regular orange.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a tropical fruit you twist open to find juicy white flesh inside.
quests.hint: Its inside looks very similar to a peeled grape.
quests.explanation: You found it! Rambutan is a tropical fruit you twist open to find juicy white flesh inside.
quests.funFact: They grow in large, colorful clusters on tropical evergreen trees.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is one of the largest tree fruits in the world, with a bumpy green shell.
quests.hint: Unlike most fruit, it grows straight out of the tree's thick trunk.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Jackfruit is one of the largest tree fruits in the world, with a bumpy green shell.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a single jackfruit can weigh up to 100 pounds!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a fruit you peel to reveal juicy, translucent white flesh inside.
quests.hint: Inside, its flesh is white, juicy, and almost see-through.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Lychee is a fruit you peel to reveal juicy, translucent white flesh inside.
quests.funFact: Did you know? lychees have a rough, bumpy red shell with sweet, translucent white flesh inside.

quests.instruction: Which one is a fruit whose flowers are also used to make a sweet, fragrant syrup?
quests.hint: It grows on a bush, in bunches rather than alone.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Elderberry is a fruit whose flowers are also used to make a sweet, fragrant syrup.
quests.funFact: They are very popular for making dark, rich jellies and pies.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a fuzzy-looking tropical fruit with sweet, translucent flesh hiding inside.
quests.hint: Twist or peel it open to find sweet, juicy white flesh inside.
quests.explanation: Yes! Rambutan is a fuzzy-looking tropical fruit with sweet, translucent flesh hiding inside.
quests.funFact: Did you know? rambutans look like lychees but are covered in soft, hairy spikes.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a fruit hiding many shiny black seeds inside its creamy flesh.
quests.hint: Its texture inside is soft and creamy, not crunchy at all.
quests.explanation: That's right! Custard Apple is a fruit hiding many shiny black seeds inside its creamy flesh.
quests.funFact: It is also known as a cherimoya in many parts of the world.

quests.instruction: Tap the fruit that is a tart little berry too small to enjoy comfortably one at a time.
quests.hint: It's very small, tart, and dark purple in color.
quests.explanation: Great job! Elderberry is a tart little berry too small to enjoy comfortably one at a time.
quests.funFact: Did you know? elderberries are tiny, dark purple berries that grow in large clusters.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is a tiny dark purple berry that grows in flat clusters on a bush?
quests.hint: It grows in wide, flat clusters that spread out like a little umbrella.
quests.explanation: You got it! Elderberry is a tiny dark purple berry that grows in flat clusters on a bush.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they must be cooked before eating, as raw elderberries can make you sick.

quests.instruction: Which one is a tangy-sweet tropical fruit with ridges running down its length?
quests.hint: Its taste is a mix of sweet and tangy, like a blend of other fruits.
quests.explanation: Well done! Star Fruit is a tangy-sweet tropical fruit with ridges running down its length.
quests.funFact: Did you know? the entire fruit is completely edible, including the waxy yellow skin.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a knobby yellow fruit with fuzzy skin, related to apples and pears.
quests.hint: It's closely related to two other fruits with smoother, sweeter cousins.
quests.explanation: Correct! Quince is a knobby yellow fruit with fuzzy skin, related to apples and pears.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a quince looks like a lumpy, yellow pear but is completely rock hard.

quests.instruction: Which fruit do you know that is a small round berry with a thin, translucent, striped skin?
quests.hint: Its skin is so thin and see-through you can spot tiny veins inside.
quests.explanation: Super! Gooseberry is a small round berry with a thin, translucent, striped skin.
quests.funFact: In the wild, they grow on bushes covered in sharp thorns.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a round fruit whose crunchy seeds are eaten right along with the flesh.
quests.hint: Its skin usually stays green, even when the fruit is ready to eat.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Guava is a round fruit whose crunchy seeds are eaten right along with the flesh.
quests.funFact: Did you know? guavas are tropical fruits that smell incredibly sweet and floral.

quests.instruction: Which one is a fruit almost always cooked into jelly, jam, or a sweet paste?
quests.hint: Its sweet smell can fill an entire room, even before cooking.
quests.explanation: You found it! Quince is a fruit almost always cooked into jelly, jam, or a sweet paste.
quests.funFact: Did you know? you cannot eat a raw quince; it is far too hard and sour.

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a small tart berry that comes in red, black, or white varieties.
quests.hint: It comes in a few colors: red, black, or even white.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Currant is a small tart berry that comes in red, black, or white varieties.
quests.funFact: Did you know? currants are tiny, extremely tart berries that grow on bushes.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a small round fruit with a fine fuzz covering its pale green skin.
quests.hint: Faint stripes run down its skin from top to bottom.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Gooseberry is a small round fruit with a fine fuzz covering its pale green skin.
quests.funFact: Did you know? gooseberries are small, tart berries that often have faint stripes on their skin.

quests.instruction: Which one is a fruit whose dark juice can easily stain your fingers purple?
quests.hint: It grows on a tree whose leaves are a favorite food of silkworms.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Mulberry is a fruit whose dark juice can easily stain your fingers purple.
quests.funFact: A mulberry tree drops so much fruit it can stain a sidewalk purple.

quests.instruction: Which one is a soft, juicy fruit that looks like a stretched-out blackberry?
quests.hint: Its juice is famous for staining fingers a deep purple.
quests.explanation: Yes! Mulberry is a soft, juicy fruit that looks like a stretched-out blackberry.
quests.funFact: Did you know? mulberries look exactly like long, thin blackberries growing on a large tree.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a tart little berry that grows on a thorny bush.
quests.hint: It grows on a bush covered in small, sharp thorns.
quests.explanation: That's right! Gooseberry is a tart little berry that grows on a thorny bush.
quests.funFact: Did you know? some varieties of gooseberries actually have tiny, fuzzy hairs on them.

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a soft tropical fruit whose scooped-out flesh has a custard-like texture.
quests.hint: You scoop out its soft flesh with a spoon, leaving shiny black seeds behind.
quests.explanation: Great job! Custard Apple is a soft tropical fruit whose scooped-out flesh has a custard-like texture.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a custard apple has green, scaly skin that looks a bit like a reptile.
